name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  intro x
  induction post <;> simp only [substOld]
  all_goals
    try (repeat' split)
    all_goals try simp only [Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars, Lambda.LExpr.LExpr.getVars, List.mem_append] at *
    all_goals grind only

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  have app {a b c d : List Expression.Ident} (h : a.Subset c) (k : b.Subset d) :
      (a ++ b).Subset (c ++ d) :=
    List.Subset.app (List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ h)
      (List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ k)
  intro h
  induction h
  all_goals try exact List.nil_subset _
  all_goals try assumption
  all_goals try (expose_names; exact app a_ih a_ih_1)
  all_goals try (expose_names; exact app (app a_ih a_ih_1) a_ih_2)
  unfold extractOldExprVars
  split
  · exact fun _ hx => hx
  · next bad =>
      have hf := ‹IsOldPred _ → IsFvar _› (by constructor)
      cases hf
      exfalso
      apply bad
      rfl
  · exact app ‹_› ‹_›

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have hn := InitStatesNotDefined hi
  have hl := UpdateStatesLength hu
  have hl' := InitStatesLength hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit hl'
    (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' hn hu) (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  rw [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu]
  unfold updatedStates
  rw [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate hl (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu))
  · rw [List.unzip_zip hl, List.unzip_zip hl']
    intro k hk hk'
    simpa [hn k hk'] using UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext a
  by_contra ha
  have hc : Continuous (fun x => ⟪f x, f a⟫_ℝ) := Continuous.inner' f (fun _ => f a) hf continuous_const
  have hp : 0 < ⟪f a, f a⟫_ℝ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg' (Ne.symm (mt inner_self_eq_zero'.mp ha))
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hball⟩ := Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc) a hp
  let φ : ContDiffBump a := ⟨r / 2, r, half_pos hr, half_lt_self hr⟩
  have ht : IsTestFunction (fun x => φ x • f a) :=
    IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const
  have hcont := φ.continuous.mul hc
  have hint := hcont.integrable_of_hasCompactSupport
    φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right (μ := μ)
  have hn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * ⟪f x, f a⟫_ℝ := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.support φ
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hball (φ.support_eq ▸ hx)).le
    · simp only [Function.notMem_support.mp hx, zero_mul, le_refl]
  have hpos := integral_pos_of_integrable_nonneg_nonzero hcont hint hn
    (mul_ne_zero (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hr)).ne' hp.ne')
  have hz := hg _ ht
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hz
  exact (ne_of_gt hpos) hz

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) t
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ
      (fun s => ∂[j] (fun y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i)) x
  have hJt : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) x i
  have hd (j : Fin d) :
      ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t =
      ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -
      ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff _ (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) (j, i))]
    simp_rw [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix _ (hA.of_le (ENat.LEInfty.out))]
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
      fderiv_fun_sub (hEd _ _).differentiableAt (hEd _ _).differentiableAt]
    change ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -
      ∂[j] (∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x = _
    rw [Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j)]
  have hg :
      ∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x =
      (1 / 𝓕.ε₀) * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    have he : (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) =
        (fun y => (1 / 𝓕.ε₀) * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y) := by
      funext y
      have := ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1
      change (∇ ⬝ (A.electricField 𝓕.c t)) y = _
      simpa only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_div, one_mul, mul_one, mul_comm] using this
    have hs := congrArg (fun f => ∂[i] f x) he
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
      fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt,
      Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
      fderiv_const_mul (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
        (hJ.differentiable (by simp)) t).differentiableAt] at hs
    simpa only [_root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis] using hs
  calc _
    _= ∂ₜ (fun t =>
      1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) * ∑ j, Space.deriv j (fun x => magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c A t x (j, i)) x -
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity 𝓕.c J t x i) t := by
        conv_lhs =>
          enter [1]
          change fun t => ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) t
          enter [t]
          rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time
            (hA.of_le (right_eq_inf.mp rfl)) _),
            time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
    _ = 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) *
        ∑ j, ∂ₜ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t -
        1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
      rw [Time.deriv_eq,
        fderiv_fun_sub
          ((Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).const_mul _).differentiableAt
          (hJt.const_mul _).differentiableAt,
        fderiv_const_mul (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt,
        fderiv_const_mul hJt.differentiableAt,
        fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt]
      simp only [Time.deriv_eq, _root_.sum_apply, _root_.sub_apply,
        _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    _ = _ := by
      simp only [hd, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, FreeSpace.c_sq]
      field_simp
      <;> ring

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  induction (Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis b) using Submodule.span_induction
  case mem x hx =>
    rcases hx with ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    induction (Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis a) using Submodule.span_induction
    case mem x hx =>
      rcases hx with ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul]
      let q0 := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))
      let q1 := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs'))
      let q2 := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs))
      let q3 := ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))
      calc _
        /- Simplify the signs. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul]
          rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
          rw [smul_sub, smul_comm (crAnTimeOrderSign _) ]
        /- Splitting the time-ordered lists. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
          (q0 *
              q1 *
              ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) *
              q2 *
              q3 -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
          q0 *
              q1 *
              ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) *
              q2 *
              q3) := by
          have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
            (by simp_all)
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp, h1]
          have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
            (by simp [hφψ, hψφ])
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by norm_num, h2]
          repeat rw [ofCrAnListF_append]
          simp only [q0, q1, q2, q3, map_mul,
    Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (q0 *
              q1 *
              ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
              q2 *
              q3) := by
            rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
            simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append,
              Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul, mul_sub,
              Algebra.mul_smul_comm, sub_mul]
      dsimp [q0, q1, q2, q3]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      repeat rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
      simp only [ List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h1 ⊢
      rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (not_ne_iff.mp hq).symm,
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
    case zero => simp only [zero_mul, map_zero, mul_zero]
    case add x y hx hy hpx hpy =>
      simp_all only [map_mul, add_mul, map_add, mul_add]
    case smul r x hx hpx =>
      simp_all only [map_mul, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]
  case zero => simp only [mul_zero, map_zero]
  case add x y hx hy hpx hpy =>
    simp_all only [ mul_add, map_add]
  case smul r x hx hpx =>
    simp_all only [map_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have lc := der.wf.2.1
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case app l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    rcases ih_l rfl l.wf.2.1 with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    · rcases ih_r rfl r.wf.2.1 with w | ⟨u, h⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
        exact ⟨_, Red.abs v.lc w⟩
      · exact ⟨_, Red.appᵣ v h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.appₗ r.wf.2.1 h⟩
  case tapp der sub ih =>
    right
    cases lc with
    | tapp lc ty =>
      rcases ih rfl lc with v | ⟨u, h⟩
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := der.canonical_form_tabs v
        exact ⟨_, Red.tabs v.lc ty⟩
      · exact ⟨_, Red.tapp ty h⟩
  case let' der _ ih _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc, body⟩ := body_let.mp lc
    right
    rcases ih rfl lc with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.let_body v body⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.let_bind h body⟩
  case case der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    obtain ⟨lc, b, c⟩ := body_case.mp lc
    right
    rcases ih rfl lc with v | ⟨u, h⟩
    · obtain ⟨u, h | h⟩ := der.canonical_form_sum v
      · subst h; cases v with | inl v => exact ⟨_, Red.case_inl v b c⟩
      · subst h; cases v with | inr v => exact ⟨_, Red.case_inr v b c⟩
    · exact ⟨_, Red.case h b c⟩
  all_goals grind [→ Red.inl, → Red.inr]

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par iha ihb _ _ ha' hb' =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, hx'⟩ := iha ha'
    obtain ⟨y, hy, hy'⟩ := ihb hb'
    exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩
  case par.red_I hb ihb ha iha =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
  case par.red_K hb ihb _ ha iha =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hx⟩
  case par.red_S hb ihb _ _ ha iha =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hx hb) (.par hy hb)⟩
  case red_I.par hc ha =>
    cases I_irreducible _ hc
    exact ⟨_, ha, .red_I _⟩
  case red_K.par ha hb =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, hx, .red_K ..⟩
  case red_S.par ha hc =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, hx, hy, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .par (.par hx hc) (.par hy hc), .red_S ..⟩
  all_goals refine ⟨_, .refl _, ?_⟩; constructor <;> assumption

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s t hr μ
  constructor <;> intro u ht <;> cases hr with
  | choice h =>
    cases ht with
    | choiceL ht =>
      obtain ⟨v, hv, hr⟩ := by first | exact h.follow_fst ht | exact h.follow_snd ht
      exact ⟨v, Tr.choiceL hv, ChoiceBisim.bisim hr⟩
    | choiceR ht =>
      exact ⟨u, Tr.choiceR ht, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
  | bisim h =>
    obtain ⟨v, hv, hr⟩ := by first | exact h.follow_fst ht | exact h.follow_snd ht
    exact ⟨v, hv, ChoiceBisim.bisim hr⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let C_i := (BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_H := Code.distFromCode f C_i
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 (⟨i, by omega⟩)
  let d_i_plus_steps := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩
  have h_d_i_gt_0 : d_i > 0 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, d_i]
    omega
  obtain ⟨g', h_g'_mem, h_g'_min_card⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i, d_fw
    = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    let S := (fun (g : C_i) => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps
      f g).ncard) '' Set.univ
    obtain ⟨g, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem (show S.Nonempty from
      ⟨_, ⟨⟨0, C_i.zero_mem⟩, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩⟩)
    exact ⟨g, g.property, hg.symm⟩
  have h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size : (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps := by
    change (Δ₀(f, g') : ℕ∞) ≤ ↑d_fw * ((2 ^ steps : ℕ) : ℕ∞)
    rw [←ENat.coe_mul, ENat.coe_le_coe, h_g'_min_card]
    set ΔH := Finset.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x) Finset.univ
    set Y_bad := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
    simp only at *
    have hFinType_Y_bad : Fintype Y_bad := by exact Fintype.ofFinite ↑Y_bad
    have h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points : ΔH ⊆ Finset.biUnion Y_bad.toFinset
        (t := fun y => ((qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
          (h_i_add_steps := by apply Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right_of_le; omega) (y := y)) ''
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin ((2:ℕ)^steps)))).toFinset) := by
      intro x hx_in_ΔH;
      simp only [mem_filter, ΔH] at hx_in_ΔH
      let y_of_x := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps x
      apply Finset.mem_biUnion.mpr; use y_of_x
      have h_elemenet_Y_bad : y_of_x ∈ Y_bad.toFinset :=
        Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, hx_in_ΔH.2⟩
      simp only [h_elemenet_Y_bad]
      simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range, mem_image, mem_univ, true_and]
      use (pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
        (h_i_add_steps := by omega) (x := x))
      exact is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps (by omega)
        (x := x) (y := y_of_x).mp (by rfl)
    apply (Finset.card_le_card h_ΔH_subset_bad_fiber_points).trans
    apply Finset.card_biUnion_le.trans
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ y ∈ Y_bad.toFinset, 2 ^ steps := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro y hy
        simp only [coe_univ, Set.image_univ, Set.toFinset_range]
        exact (Finset.card_image_le).trans_eq (by simp)
      _ = Y_bad.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
        simp only [Finset.sum_const, Set.toFinset_card, smul_eq_mul, ← Nat.card_coe_set_eq, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card]
  have h_dist_bridge : d_H ≤ d_fw * 2 ^ steps :=
    le_trans (show d_H ≤ (hammingDist f g' : ℕ∞) from
      sInf_le ⟨g', h_g'_mem, le_rfl⟩) h_dist_le_fw_dist_times_fiber_size
  have h_fw_bound : 2 * d_fw ≤ d_i_plus_steps - 1 := by
    exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt)
  have h_algebraic_identity : (d_i_plus_steps - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one, d_i_plus_steps, d_i]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ←Nat.pow_add, ←Nat.pow_add];
    rw [show ℓ + 𝓡 - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ + 𝓡 - i by omega,
      show ℓ - (↑i + steps) + steps = ℓ - i by omega]
  change 2 * d_H < (d_i : ℕ∞)
  apply lt_of_le_of_lt (mul_le_mul_left' h_dist_bridge 2)
  have hn : 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) < d_i := by
    apply Nat.lt_of_le_pred h_d_i_gt_0
    rw [Nat.pred_eq_sub_one, ← h_algebraic_identity, ← mul_assoc]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ h_fw_bound
  exact_mod_cast hn

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  set fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1)
    (h_i_add_steps := by simp only; omega) (y := y)
  set x₀ := fiberMap 0
  set x₁ := fiberMap 1
  have hq (k : Fin 2) :
      (AdditiveNTT.qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
    have h := iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)
    simp only [Subtype.eq_iff] at h
    rw [h.symm]
    exact congrArg Subtype.val
      (generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
        (fiberMap k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).symm
  have h_fiber_diff : x₁.val - x₀.val = 1 := by
    have h0 := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 0
    have h1 := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y 1
    change (x₁ : L) - (x₀ : L) = 1
    dsimp only at h0 h1
    rw [show x₁ = _ from h1, show x₀ = _ from h0]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, Fin.isValue, one_ne_zero, ↓reduceIte, one_smul, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_basis,
    add_zero, normalizedWᵢ_eval_βᵢ_eq_1, zero_smul, zero_add, add_sub_cancel_right]
  set P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  set P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_P_i_eval := evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs
  have he (k : Fin 2) : P_i.eval (fiberMap k).val =
      P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    simp only [h_P_i_eval, Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, hq, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, P_i, P₀,
    P₁]
  calc f_i_plus_1 y
    _ = P₀.eval y.val * (1 - r_chal) + P₁.eval y.val * r_chal := by
      change P_i.eval x₀.val * ((1 - r_chal) * x₁.val - r_chal) +
        P_i.eval x₁.val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * x₀.val) = _
      rw [he 0, he 1]
      rw [sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp h_fiber_diff]
      ring
    _ = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
      simp only [evenRefinement, oddRefinement, P₀, P₁, P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs]
      conv_lhs => enter [1]; rw [mul_comm, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul]
      conv_lhs => enter [2]; rw [mul_comm, ←Polynomial.eval_C_mul]
      rw [←Polynomial.eval_add]
      congr
      simp_rw [mul_sum, ←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro j hj
      simp only [Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul]
      ring

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => omega
  | succ n ih =>
    cases n with
    | zero =>
      simp only [zero_add, zero_lt_one, forall_const]
      intro u hp
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u)] at hp
      simp_rw [prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
        (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
        Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hp
      have h := hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hp
      have hu : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
        funext i
        match i with
        | 0 => rfl
        | 1 => rfl
      exact hu.symm ▸ h
    | succ n =>
      intro _ u hp
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form u] at hp
      change Pr_{let r ← $ᵖ (Fin (n + 1 + 1) → F)}[
        multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close (MC := MC) u e
          (r (Fin.last (n + 1))) (fun i => r i.castSucc)] > _ at hp
      rw [prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun
        (multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close (MC := MC) u e)] at hp
      have hr := prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) u e hp
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
      apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
      apply lt_of_lt_of_le hr
      apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
      intro r hr
      exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC (ih (Nat.succ_pos _)) u ⟨r, hr⟩

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hb⟩ := boundedu
  let f (n : ℕ) : Fin 4 → Set.Icc B T := fun k => ⟨u (n + k), hb _⟩
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ := Set.finite_univ.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem
    (f := f) (fun _ => Set.mem_univ _)
  have eqs : ∀ m, u (i + m) = u (j + m) := by
    intro m
    induction m using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h m ih =>
      by_cases hm : m < 4
      · exact congrArg Subtype.val (congrFun he ⟨m, hm⟩)
      · have step (k : ℕ) (hk : 1 ≤ k) (hk' : k ≤ 4) :
            u (i + m - k) = u (j + m - k) := by
          simpa only [Nat.add_sub_assoc (show k ≤ m by omega)] using
            ih (m - k) (by omega)
        apply Int.cast_injective (α := ℝ)
        rw [(hu (i + m) (by omega)).1, (hu (j + m) (by omega)).1,
          step 1 (by decide) (by decide), step 2 (by decide) (by decide),
          step 3 (by decide) (by decide), step 4 (by decide) (by decide)]
  refine ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have h := (eqs (n - i)).symm
  simpa only [Nat.add_sub_of_le hn,
    show j + (n - i) = n + (j - i) by omega] using h

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have h : ∀ A : Set S, Aᶜ ∈ P ↔ A ∉ P := by
    grind
  have hc : P.card = Pᶜ.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    <;> simp [← h]
  have hn := P.card_add_card_compl
  rw [← hc, Fintype.card_set] at hn
  have hp := Fintype.card_pos (α := S)
  have he : 2 ^ Fintype.card S = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 := by
    rw [← pow_succ]
    congr 1
    omega
  omega

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have step (a b : Fin 9 → ℤ) (h : relation a b) (i : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ (b i - a i) * 10^i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    have hs := (hrelation a b).mp h |>.2 i
    simp only [hdigits_to_num] at hs ⊢
    have eq : (∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then b j else a j) * 10^j.1) =
        (∑ j : Fin 9, a j * 10^j.1) + (b i - a i) * 10^i.1 := by
      calc
        _ = ∑ j : Fin 9, (a j * 10^j.1 + if j = i then (b j - a j) * 10^j.1 else 0) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro j _
          split <;> ring
        _ = _ := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]; simp only [Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [eq] at hs
    rwa [add_comm]
  intro d e f h i
  have hd := step d e h.1
  have he := step e f h.2
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => hd j)
  have heq : (∑ j : Fin 9, ((e j - d j) * 10^j.1 + digits_to_num d)) =
      digits_to_num e + 8 * digits_to_num d := by
    simp only [sub_mul, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
    Fintype.card_fin]
    rw [← congrFun hdigits_to_num e, ← congrFun hdigits_to_num d]
    ring
  rw [heq] at hs
  have ht : 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * 10^i.1 := by
    convert dvd_add (dvd_sub (dvd_add (hd i) (he i)) hs)
      (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d)) using 1 <;> ring
  have hp : Prime (7 : ℤ) := Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by decide)
  have hn : ¬ (7 : ℤ) ∣ 10^i.1 := by
    intro hh
    have := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hh
    norm_num at this
  exact dvd_sub_comm.mp ((hp.dvd_mul.mp ht).resolve_right hn)
